description: On the table in front of you there’s a white AirPods charging case near a loose white charging cable, with another coiled cable off to the right. The left hand reaches forward to pick up the AirPods case and pulls it closer while the right hand brings the charging connector toward the case; the left hand holds the case steady as the right hand pushes the connector into the charging port, then both hands relax with the case left on the table and the cable attached.
